items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you think that the influence was felt earlier than that. You had heard Shutt in New York as early as 25 or 26, hadn't you? [INTERVIEWEE] With the Georgians.

ctx.x: You'll have to pick just the right day and early in it. The Artie shot, I would say probably had more effect on all of us than anybody else, short of Hines. And I guess, I can't figure out what records necessarily those were unless they were the Georgians. And I'm not sure that the Georgians were that well known.

No, but of course the Red Nickels. Yeah, he was on some of them. When 28 began to introduce Shutt, but you think that the influence was felt earlier than that. You had heard Shutt in New York as early as 25 or 26, hadn't you?
